theme: Every article addresses a creator-marketing decision or collaboration task; titles need not all contain KOL.
educationReview: Account access, incentives, moderation, metric provenance and interpretation. No engagement-inflation instructions or provider recommendations, no complete-detection promise, no individual authenticity verdict from one signal. Educational CTA points to a metrics guide rather than marketing a fraud-research service.
historicalAndCurrentScope: October 2025 retrospective distinguishes announcement, notice, effective and expiry dates. Trend workflow explicitly does not claim a captured live ranking. Current blocked help and untested account or provider capabilities are disclosed where relevant.
quantitativeReview: Numerical scenarios are labeled hypothetical; rate examples checked arithmetically. Platform self-reported historical figures retain dates and limited meaning. No invented industry engagement benchmarks or customer outcomes.
bilingualReview: Parallel sections retain the same task, source scope, examples and limitations. English count is answer plus section bodies only. Chinese depth is evaluated by equivalence, not by an artificial character quota.
assetReview: 30 independent 1672x941 JPEG sRGB covers, plus two distinct 1200x675 body photographs. All generated originals and prompts retained internally. Public images, captions and alt contain no AI-production notices. Cover alt text was corrected to visible compositions during final contact-sheet review.
components: Task-specific four-row decision tables and six-item static reference checklists. No calculators or download buttons were added; no calculator or downloadable-file checks are claimed.
state: Research and QA performed in independent local preview before this handoff. User authorized GitHub upload; formal integration, merge and deployment remain pending.
